about_the_game:
Your face is the controller!

Will you reach the goal first, or will your facial muscles give up first?

“Jaw Jump!” is a 2D action game controlled by facial expression recognition using your webcam.

Open your mouth to jump, and change the direction of your face to adjust the direction of your jump.

Your goal is to keep climbing higher and higher.

The concept is simple, but precise control is required, making the game more difficult than it looks.

With privacy in mind, the game runs entirely offline.

Camera footage is used only for gameplay input and real-time display, and is never recorded, stored, or transmitted externally.

Playing with a webcam is recommended, but mouse controls are also supported.

  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3
